item.title: Dems aim to block Iran war funding. And, Army delays lead azide detonation in Iowa
item.description: Congress needs to pass a funding measure to avoid a shutdown next month, providing Dems an opportunity to leverage power. And, the Army says waiting to detonate lead azide could become dangerous.

item.title: The U.K. and EU hold a rare summit to strengthen ties
item.description: A decade after the people of Britain voted to leave the European Union, top EU officials are meeting with Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Friday, looking to mend more fences.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
item.description: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker

item.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
